title: chat.server.ts reads its system prompt, algorithm, products, shared docs, blog index and posture files from disk once at import and never refreshes them.
evidence: Root fix R24 (US-15 AC72, AC80): every chat doc is one ChatDocsState (unread | loaded | degraded | missing) in app/lib/chat-system-prompt.server.ts, changed only by its pure transition (table test in chat-system-prompt.server.test.ts). Nothing is read at import: app/entry.server.tsx calls chatDocs() once at server start (test: app/entry.server.chat-docs.test.ts). Writing style, answer bank, router prompt and blog index absent or blank make it degraded, one Sentry error per file; chat answers without them as before. createChatDocs(root) is the test seam. chat.server.ts and chat-router.server.ts read only through requireChatDocs(). Docs still read once per process (restart to change).
